passages.text: Plurima qua medium Roma terebat iter:

passages.text: Nunc tua Caesareis cinguntur limina donis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.28.6
passages.text: Et fora tot numeras, Iane, quot ora geris.

passages.label: Mart. 10.28.7
passages.text: At tu, sancte pater, tanto pro munere gratus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.28.8
passages.text: Ferrea perpetua claustra tuere sera.

passages.label: Mart. 10.29.1
passages.text: Quam mihi mittebas Saturni tempore lancem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.29.2
passages.text: Misisti dominae, Sextiliane, tuae;

passages.label: Mart. 10.29.3
passages.text: Et quam donabas dictis a Marte Kalendis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.29.4
passages.text: De nostra prasina est synthesis empta toga.

passages.label: Mart. 10.29.5
passages.text: Iam constare tibi gratis coepere puellae:

passages.text: Muneribus futuis, Sextiliane, meis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.1
passages.text: O temperatae dulce Formiae litus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.2
passages.text: Vos, cum severi fugit oppidum Martis

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.3
passages.text: Et inquietas fessus exuit curas,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.4
passages.text: Apollinaris omnibus locis praefert.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.5
passages.text: Non ille sanctae dulce Tibur uxoris,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.6
passages.text: Nec Tusculanos Algidosve secessus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.7
passages.text: Praeneste nec sic Antiumque miratur;

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.8
passages.text: Non blanda Circe Dardanisve Caieta

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.9
passages.text: Desiderantur, nec Marica nec Liris,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.10
passages.text: Nec in Lucrina lota Salmacis vena.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.11
passages.text: Hic summa leni stringitur Thetis vento;

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.12
passages.text: Nec languet aequor, viva sed quies ponti

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.13
passages.text: Pictam phaselon adiuvante fert aura,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.14
passages.text: Sicut puellae non amantis aestatem

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.15
passages.text: Mota salubre purpura venit frigus.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.16
passages.text: Nec saeta longo quaerit in mari praedam,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.17
passages.text: Sed a cubili lectuloque iactatam

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.18
passages.text: Spectatus alte lineam trahit piscis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.19
passages.text: Si quando Nereus sentit Aeoli regnum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.20
passages.text: Ridet procellas tuta de suo mensa:

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.21
passages.text: Piscina rhombum pascit et lupos vernas,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.22
passages.text: Natat ad magistrum delicata muraena,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.23
passages.text: Nomenculator mugilem citat notum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.24
passages.text: Et adesse iussi prodeunt senes mulli.

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.25
passages.text: Frui sed istis quando Roma permittit?

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.26
passages.text: Quot Formianos inputat dies annus

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.27
passages.text: Negotiosis rebus urbis haerenti?

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.28
passages.text: O ianitores vilicique felices!

passages.label: Mart. 10.30.29
passages.text: Dominis parantur ista, serviunt vobis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.31.1
passages.text: Addixti servum nummis here mille ducentis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.31.2
passages.text: Ut bene cenares, Calliodore, semel.

passages.label: Mart. 10.31.3
passages.text: Nec bene cenasti: mullus tibi quattuor emptus

passages.label: Mart. 10.31.4
passages.text: Librarum cenae pompa caputque fuit.

passages.text: Exclamare libet: 'Non est hic, inprobe, non est

passages.text: Piscis: homo est; hominem, Calliodore, comes.'

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.1
passages.text: Haec mihi quae colitur violis pictura rosisque,

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.2
passages.text: Quos referat voltus, Caediciane, rogas?

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.3
passages.text: Talis erat Marcus mediis Antonius annis

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.4
passages.text: Primus: in hoc iuvenem se videt ore senex.

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.5
passages.text: Ars utinam mores animumque effingere posset!

passages.label: Mart. 10.32.6
passages.text: Pulchrior in terris nulla tabella foret.

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.1
passages.text: Simplicior priscis, Munati Galle, Sabinis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.2
passages.text: Cecropium superas qui bonitate senem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.3
passages.text: Sic tibi consoceri claros retinere penates

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.4
passages.text: Perpetua natae det face casta Venus:

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.5
passages.text: Ut tu, si viridi tinctos aerugine versus

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.6
passages.text: Forte malus livor dixerit esse meos,

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.7
passages.text: Ut facis, a nobis abigas, nec scribere quemquam

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.8
passages.text: Talia contendas carmina, qui legitur.

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.9
passages.text: Hunc servare modum nostri novere libelli,

passages.label: Mart. 10.33.10
passages.text: Parcere personis, dicere de vitiis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.34.1
passages.text: Di tibi dent quidquid, Caesar Traiane, mereris

passages.label: Mart. 10.34.2
passages.text: Et rata perpetuo quae tribuere velint:

passages.text: Qui sua restituis spoliato iura patrono

passages.label: Mart. 10.34.4
passages.text: —Libertis exul non erit ille suis—,

passages.text: Dignus es, ut possis totum servare clientem:

passages.label: Mart. 10.34.6
passages.text: Ut—liceat tantum vera probare—potes.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.1
passages.text: Omnes Sulpiciam legant puellae,

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.2
passages.text: Uni quae cupiunt viro placere;

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.3
passages.text: Omnes Sulpiciam legant mariti,

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.4
passages.text: Uni qui cupiunt placere nuptae.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.5
passages.text: Non haec Colchidos adserit furorem

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.6
passages.text: Diri prandia nec refert Thyestae;

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.7
passages.text: Scyllam, Byblida nec fuisse credit:

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.8
passages.text: Sed castos docet et probos amores,

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.9
passages.text: Lusus, delicias facetiasque.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.10
passages.text: Cuius carmina qui bene aestimarit,

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.11
passages.text: Nullam dixerit esse nequiorem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.12
passages.text: Nullam dixerit esse sanctiorem.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.13
passages.text: Tales Egeriae iocos fuisse

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.14
passages.text: Udo crediderim Numae sub antro.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.15
passages.text: Hac condiscipula vel hac magistra

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.16
passages.text: Esses doctior et pudica, Sappho:

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.17
passages.text: Sed tecum pariter simulque visam

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.18
passages.text: Durus Sulpiciam Phaon amaret.

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.19
passages.text: Frustra: namque ea nec Tonantis uxor

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.20
passages.text: Nec Bacchi nec Apollinis puella

passages.label: Mart. 10.35.21
passages.text: Erepto sibi viveret Caleno.

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.1
passages.text: Inproba Massiliae quidquid fumaria cogunt,

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.2
passages.text: Accipit aetatem quisquis ab igne cadus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.3
passages.text: A te, Munna, venit: miseris tu mittis amicis

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.4
passages.text: Per freta, per longas toxica saeva vias;

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.5
passages.text: Nec facili pretio, sed quo contenta Falerni

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.6
passages.text: Testa sit aut cellis Setia cara suis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.7
passages.text: Non venias quare tam longo tempore Romam,

passages.label: Mart. 10.36.8
passages.text: Haec puto causa tibi est, ne tua vina bibas.

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.1
passages.text: Iuris et aequarum cultor sanctissime legum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.2
passages.text: Veridico Latium qui regis ore forum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.3
passages.text: Municipi, Materne, tuo veterique sodali

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.4
passages.text: Callai+cum mandas siquid ad Oceanum—.

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.5
passages.text: An Laurentino turpis in litore ranas

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.6
passages.text: Et satius tenues ducere credis acus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.7
passages.text: Ad sua captivum quam saxa remittere mullum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.8
passages.text: Visus erit libris qui minor esse tribus?

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.9
passages.text: Et fatuam summa cenare pelorida mensa

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.10
passages.text: Quosque tegit levi cortice concha brevis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.11
passages.text: Ostrea Baianis quam non liventia testis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.12
passages.text: Quae domino pueri non prohibente vorent?

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.13
passages.text: Hic olidam clamosus ages in retia volpem

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.14
passages.text: Mordebitque tuos sordida praeda canes:

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.15
passages.text: Illic piscoso modo vix educta profundo

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.16
passages.text: Inpedient lepores umida lina meos.—

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.17
passages.text: Dum loquor, ecce redit sporta piscator inani,

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.18
passages.text: Venator capta maele superbus adest:

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.19
passages.text: Omnis ab urbano venit ad mare cena macello.

passages.label: Mart. 10.37.20
passages.text: Callai+cum mandas siquid ad Oceanum—.

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.1
passages.text: O molles tibi quindecim, Calene,

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.2
passages.text: Quos cum Sulpicia tua iugales

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.3
passages.text: Indulsit deus et peregit annos!

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.4
passages.text: O nox omnis et hora, quae notata est

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.5
passages.text: Caris litoris Indici lapillis!

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.6
passages.text: O quae proelia, quas utrimque pugnas

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.7
passages.text: Felix lectulus et lucerna vidit

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.8
passages.text: Nimbis ebria Nicerotianis!

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.9
passages.text: Vixisti tribus, o Calene, lustris:

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.10
passages.text: Aetas haec tibi tota conputatur

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.11
passages.text: Et solos numeras dies mariti.

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.12
passages.text: Ex illis tibi si diu rogatam

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.13
passages.text: Lucem redderet Atropos vel unam,

passages.label: Mart. 10.38.14
passages.text: Malles, quam Pyliam quater senectam.

passages.label: Mart. 10.39.1
passages.text: Consule te Bruto quod iuras, Lesbia, natam,

passages.label: Mart. 10.39.2
passages.text: Mentiris. Nata es, Lesbia, rege Numa?

passages.label: Mart. 10.39.3
passages.text: Sic quoque mentiris. Namque, ut tua saecula narrant,

passages.label: Mart. 10.39.4
passages.text: Ficta Prometheo diceris esse luto.

passages.label: Mart. 10.40.1
passages.text: Semper cum mihi diceretur esse

passages.label: Mart. 10.40.2
passages.text: Secreto mea Polla cum cinaedo,

passages.label: Mart. 10.40.3
passages.text: Inrupi, Lupe. Non erat cinaedus.

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.1
passages.text: Mense novo Iani veterem, Proculeia, maritum

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.2
passages.text: Deseris atque iubes res sibi habere suas.

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.3
passages.text: Quid, rogo, quid factum est? subiti quae causa doloris?

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.4
passages.text: Nil mihi respondes? Dicam ego: praetor erat.

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.5
passages.text: Constatura fuit Megalensis purpura centum

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.6
passages.text: Milibus, ut nimium munera parca dares,

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.7
passages.text: Et populare sacrum bis milia dena tulisset.

passages.label: Mart. 10.41.8
passages.text: Discidium non est hoc, Proculeia: lucrum est.

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.1
passages.text: Tam dubia est lanugo tibi, tam mollis, ut illam

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.2
passages.text: Halitus et soles et levis aura terat.

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.3
passages.text: Celantur simili ventura Cydonea lana,

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.4
passages.text: Pollice virgineo quae spoliata nitent.

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.5
passages.text: Fortius inpressi quotiens tibi basia quinque,

passages.label: Mart. 10.42.6
passages.text: Barbatus labris, Dindyme, fio tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 10.43.1
passages.text: Septima iam, Phileros, tibi conditur uxor in agro.

passages.label: Mart. 10.43.2
passages.text: Plus nulli, Phileros, quam tibi, reddit ager.

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.1
passages.text: Quinte Caledonios Ovidi visure Britannos

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.2
passages.text: Et viridem Tethyn Oceanumque patrem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.3
passages.text: Ergo Numae colles et Nomentana relinquis

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.4
passages.text: Otia, nec retinet rusque focusque senem?

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.5
passages.text: Gaudia tu differs, at non et stamina differt

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.6
passages.text: Atropos, atque omnis scribitur hora tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.7
passages.text: Praestiteris caro—quis non hoc laudet?—amico,

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.8
passages.text: Ut potior vita sit tibi sancta fides;

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.9
passages.text: Sed reddare tuis tandem mansure Sabinis

passages.label: Mart. 10.44.10
passages.text: Teque tuas numeres inter amicitias.

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.1
passages.text: Si quid lene mei dicunt et dulce libelli,

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.2
passages.text: Si quid honorificum pagina blanda sonat,

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.3
passages.text: Hoc tu pingue putas et costam rodere mavis,

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.4
passages.text: Ilia Laurentis cum tibi demus apri.

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.5
passages.text: Vaticana bibas, si delectaris aceto:

passages.label: Mart. 10.45.6
passages.text: Non facit ad stomachum nostra lagona tuum.

passages.label: Mart. 10.46.1
passages.text: Omnia vis belle, Matho, dicere. Dic aliquando

passages.label: Mart. 10.46.2
passages.text: Et bene; dic neutrum; dic aliquando male.

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.1
passages.text: Vitam quae faciant beatiorem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.2
passages.text: Iucundissime Martialis, haec sunt:

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.3
passages.text: Res non parta labore, sed relicta;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.4
passages.text: Non ingratus ager, focus perennis;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.5
passages.text: Lis numquam, toga rara, mens quieta;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.6
passages.text: Vires ingenuae, salubre corpus;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.7
passages.text: Prudens simplicitas, pares amici;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.8
passages.text: Convictus facilis, sine arte mensa;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.9
passages.text: Nox non ebria, sed soluta curis;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.10
passages.text: Non tristis torus, et tamen pudicus;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.11
passages.text: Somnus, qui faciat breves tenebras:

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.12
passages.text: Quod sis, esse velis nihilque malis;

passages.label: Mart. 10.47.13
passages.text: Summum nec metuas diem nec optes.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.1
passages.text: Nuntiat octavam Phariae sua turba iuvencae,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.2
passages.text: Et pilata redit iamque subitque cohors.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.3
passages.text: Temperat haec thermas, nimios prior hora vapores

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.4
passages.text: Halat, et inmodico sexta Nerone calet.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.5
passages.text: Stella, Nepos, Cani, Cerialis, Flacce, venitis?

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.6
passages.text: Septem sigma capit, sex sumus, adde Lupum.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.7
passages.text: Exoneraturas ventrem mihi vilica malvas

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.8
passages.text: Adtulit et varias, quas habet hortus, opes,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.9
passages.text: In quibus est lactuca sedens et tonsile porrum,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.10
passages.text: Nec deest ructatrix menta nec herba salax;

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.11
passages.text: Secta coronabunt rutatos ova lacertos,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.12
passages.text: Et madidum thynni de sale sumen erit.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.13
passages.text: Gustus in his; una ponetur cenula mensa,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.14
passages.text: Haedus, inhumani raptus ab ore lupi,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.15
passages.text: Et quae non egeant ferro structoris ofellae,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.16
passages.text: Et faba fabrorum prototomique rudes;

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.17
passages.text: Pullus ad haec cenisque tribus iam perna superstes

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.18
passages.text: Addetur. Saturis mitia poma dabo,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.19
passages.text: De Nomentana vinum sine faece lagona,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.20
passages.text: Quae bis Frontino consule trima fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.21
passages.text: Accedent sine felle ioci nec mane timenda

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.22
passages.text: Libertas et nil quod tacuisse velis:

passages.text: De prasino conviva meus venetoque loquatur,

passages.label: Mart. 10.48.24

passages.label: Mart. 10.49.1
passages.text: Cum potes amethystinos trientes

passages.label: Mart. 10.49.2

passages.text: Propinas modo conditum Sabinum

passages.text: Frangat Idumaeas tristis Victoria palmas,

passages.label: Mart. 10.50.2
passages.text: Plange, Favor, saeva pectora nuda manu;

passages.text: Mutet Honor cultus, et iniquis munera flammis

passages.text: Mitte coronatas, Gloria maesta, comas.

passages.text: Heu facinus! prima fraudatus, Scorpe, iuventa

passages.text: Curribus illa tuis semper properata brevisque

passages.text: Sidera iam Tyrius Phrixei respicit agni

passages.text: Sed nec Marcelli Pompeianumque, nec illic

passages.text: Sunt triplices thermae, nec fora iuncta quater,

passages.text: Nec Capitolini summum penetrale Tonantis,

passages.text: Totis, Galle, iubes tibi me servire diebus

passages.text: Argenti libram mittebas; facta selibra est,

passages.text: Hic mihi quando dies meus est? iactamur in alto

passages.text: Sic te frequentes audiant capillati

passages.text: Albae leone flammeo calent luces

passages.text: Mausoli saxis pyramidumque legis.

passages.text: Bis mea Romano spectata est vita Tarento,

passages.text: Et nihil extremos perdidit ante rogos:

passages.text: Quinque dedit pueros, totidem mihi Iuno puellas,

passages.text: Cluserunt omnes lumina nostra manus.

passages.text: Contigeris regina meos si Polla libellos,

passages.text: Ille tuus vates, Heliconis gloria nostri,

passages.text: Non tamen erubuit lascivo dicere versu

passages.text: Cum te municipem Corinthiorum

passages.label: Mart. 10.65.2
passages.text: Iactes, Charmenion, negante nullo,

passages.text: Cur frater tibi dicor, ex Hiberis

passages.text: An voltu similes videmur esse?

passages.text: Tu flexa nitidus coma vagaris,

passages.text: Levis dropace tu cotidiano,

passages.text: Hirsutis ego cruribus genisque;

passages.text: Os blaesum tibi debilisque lingua est,

passages.text: Nobis filia fortius loquetur:

passages.text: Tam dispar aquilae columba non est,

passages.text: Nec dorcas rigido fugax leoni.

passages.text: Quare desine me vocare fratrem,

passages.label: Mart. 10.66.1
passages.text: Quis, rogo, tam durus, quis tam fuit ille superbus,

passages.text: Hanc aliquis faciem nigra violare culina

passages.text: Sustinet, has uncto polluit igne comas?

passages.text: Quis potius cyathos aut quis crystalla tenebit?

passages.text: Qua sapient melius mixta Falerna manu?

passages.text: Si tam sidereos manet exitus iste ministros,

passages.text: Iuppiter utatur iam Ganymede coco.

passages.label: Mart. 10.67.1
passages.text: Pyrrhae filia, Nestoris noverca,

passages.text: Quam vidit Niobe puella canam,

passages.text: Laertes aviam senex vocavit,

passages.text: Nutricem Priamus, socrum Thyestes,

passages.text: Iam cornicibus omnibus superstes,

passages.text: Hoc tandem sita prurit in sepulchro

passages.text: Calvo Plutia cum Melanthione.

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.1
passages.text: Cum tibi non Ephesos nec sit Rhodos aut Mitylene,

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.2
passages.text: Sed domus in vico, Laelia, patricio,

passages.text: Deque coloratis numquam lita mater Etruscis,

passages.text: Durus Aricina de regione pater;

passages.text: Κύριέ μου, μέλι μου, ψυχή μου congeris usque,

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.6
passages.text: —Pro pudor!—Hersiliae civis et Egeriae.

passages.text: Lectulus has voces, nec lectulus audiat omnis,

passages.text: Sed quem lascivo stravit amica viro.

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.9
passages.text: Scire cupis quo casta modo matrona loquaris?

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.10
passages.text: Numquid, cum crisas, blandior esse potes?

passages.label: Mart. 10.68.11
passages.text: Tu licet ediscas totam referasque Corinthon,

passages.text: Non tamen omnino, Laelia, Lais eris.

passages.text: Custodes das, Polla, viro, non accipis ipsa.

passages.text: Hoc est uxorem ducere, Polla, virum.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.1
passages.text: Quod mihi vix unus toto liber exeat anno,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.2
passages.text: Desidiae tibi sum, docte Potite, reus.

passages.text: Iustius at quanto mirere, quod exeat unus,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.4
passages.text: Labantur toti cum mihi saepe dies.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.5
passages.text: Non resalutantis video nocturnus amicos,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.6
passages.text: Gratulor et multis, nemo, Potite, mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.7
passages.text: Nunc ad luciferam signat mea gemma Dianam,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.8
passages.text: Nunc me prima sibi, nunc sibi quinta rapit.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.9
passages.text: Nunc consul praetorve tenet reducesque choreae,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.10
passages.text: Auditur toto saepe poeta die.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.11
passages.text: Sed nec causidico possis inpune negare,

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.12
passages.text: Nec si te rhetor grammaticusve rogent.

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.13
passages.text: Balnea post decumam lasso centumque petuntur

passages.label: Mart. 10.70.14
passages.text: Quadrantes. Fiet quando, Potite, liber?

passages.text: Quisquis laeta tuis et sera parentibus optas

passages.label: Mart. 10.71.2
passages.text: Fata, brevem titulum marmoris huius ama.

passages.label: Mart. 10.71.3
passages.text: Condidit hac caras tellure Rabirius umbras;

passages.text: Nulli sorte iacent candidiore senes:

passages.text: Bis sex lustra tori nox mitis et ultima clusit,

passages.label: Mart. 10.71.7
passages.text: Hos tamen ut primis raptos sibi quaerit in annis.

passages.text: Inprobius nihil his fletibus esse potest.

passages.text: Frustra, Blanditiae, venitis ad me

passages.text: Ad Parthos procul ite pilleatos

passages.text: Et turpes humilesque supplicesque

passages.text: Non est hic dominus, sed imperator,

passages.text: Per quem de Stygia domo reducta est

passages.text: Hoc sub principe, si sapis, caveto,

passages.text: Non quacumque manu victima caesa litat:

passages.text: Munere sed plus est et nomine gratius ipso

passages.text: Anteambulones et togatulos inter
